notes: A social game whose point is two players forming a connection in a private room is open-ended social roleplay, which is Roleplay & Avatar Sim rather than any of the housing-model presets — Life, Home Builder, Pet Care, Morph Roleplay, Animal Sim and Dress Up all build a town, a runway or a wilderness, so preset is none. The author confirmed one shared bedroom and nothing more, so interior-single is exact: the room is the entire map, there is no exterior to generate and no transition to link, which keeps this off the P3 that this genre usually carries. teleporter-link is the one option the prompt genuinely asks for, bent to the pair arriving inside the room; the teleport script itself is mechanics and out of layout's scope. With no user to ask, I read the per-pair private instance as one room served to many instances rather than several distinct maps, so it is not P4, and I kept the cosy modern styling the author chose.
